statement_blocker: The repository supplies only a finite-difference method label and a PDE-discretization gloss. It fixes no PDE or class, domain, initial or boundary data, solution notion or regularity, grid, spatial or temporal step, stencil, scheme, discrete solution, consistency/stability/convergence/solvability/error conclusion, norm, constants, quantifier order, arithmetic model, or boundary cases. Choosing a five-point Poisson, heat-equation, or hyperbolic-scheme theorem would invent proposition-changing mathematics.
target_decision: redirect the catalog method-family label to one corrected, independently reviewed, immutable-source proposition before statement or proof execution
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix the PDE and solution carriers, spatial dimension and domain, scalar field, continuous and discrete function spaces, index types, grid geometry, universes, finiteness, topology, normed structures, and all typeclass context.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose consistency, order of accuracy, discrete existence or uniqueness, stability, convergence, an error estimate, or an exact conjunction of these results.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every PDE, domain/data, regularity, grid, stencil, scheme, norm, parameter, arithmetic, and boundary case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: consistency or an order estimate for a source-selected finite-difference stencil
discrete solvability or convergence for a five-point Poisson or other elliptic scheme
stability and convergence for a semidiscrete or fully discrete parabolic scheme
a source-specific hyperbolic upwind, Lax-Friedrichs, Lax-Wendroff, or leapfrog theorem
a normed global error bound under exact regularity and mesh hypotheses
a CFL or von Neumann result separately owned by another repository target
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty, singleton, nonrectangular, nonconforming, adaptive, or zero-dimensional grids
zero, negative, unequal, or excessively large spatial and time steps
degenerate domains, corners, mixed boundaries, incompatible initial/boundary data, and ghost-cell conventions
nonsmooth coefficients, data, domains, or solutions and nonunique or nonexistent continuous solutions
singular discrete systems, multiple or nonexistent discrete solutions, and unstable parameter regimes
constant, zero, and exact-polynomial solutions; finite versus infinite time; mesh-dependent constants
exact versus floating-point arithmetic, roundoff, iterative-solver tolerance, and computation boundaries
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1395 ODE finite differences or its statement and evidence
THM-M-1461 finite elements, THM-M-1466 finite volumes, or THM-M-1460 spectral methods
THM-M-1472 Lax equivalence, THM-M-1473 CFL, or THM-M-1474 von Neumann stability
a five-point Poisson, heat-equation, or advection-scheme theorem selected without an accepted source decision
algebraic forward differences, the continuous Laplacian, or generic Taylor estimates alone
a structure or hypothesis storing the desired consistency, stability, convergence, solvability, or error result
a finite computation, numerical residual, convergence plot, benchmark, or floating-point experiment
the untrusted catalog label 已验证 or the discovery probe as source or proof evidence
